resolution.note: docs, packet shard-weights path and pinning test now match code at HEAD; ADR 0013 trigger marked superseded

title: Docs and the brain packet stop citing retired machinery
body:
Why: Qwen second audit .krn/runs/qwen-research-2/report.md N9, verified at 6d713ae: docs/program/live-records.json:5 cites scripts/shard-weights.mjs (real: scripts/lib/shard-weights.mjs) and every lane packet carries it; docs/adr/0013-repository-consolidation.md:41-48,82 and ADR 0001 describe the forwarder, krn ship and pr-preflight; docs/program/PLANS.md:22 calls preflight the cheap local bundle (it is npm run fast); README/CONTEXT command lists miss decide/adopt/plan; test/fixtures/README.md names deleted files.
Outcome: each cited text matches the code at HEAD; ADR 0013 marks its trigger superseded by the current repository shape.
Proof: grep for the stale names prints nothing outside history; npm run fast passes.
